verdict.rationale: pnpm explicitly markets itself as a drop-in replacement for npm with same CLI commands and no migration needed, and multiple community migration reports (yarn/npm/lerna to pnpm) confirm it largely works smoothly with major speed gains. However, several hands-on reports cite real friction switching over — needing --shamefully-hoist for hoisting-dependent code, no auto-install of peer deps (unlike npm7), symlink structure causing issues in some tools (e.g. Electron), and command-name collision with npm causing accidental typos. missing for 10: a documented compatibility mode/flag reference for common npm quirks, and resolution of the symlink/hoisting edge cases without workarounds.
